nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Oh no... I lost my wallet at the plaza! Can you help me?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It's a small brown wallet. I was sitting near the benches.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Thank you! Check the plaza benches, then ask the vendor.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Oh... okay. Let me know if you change your mind.
